He studied at the University of Houston's business school and worked in marine brokerage. As Royalton's chief executive, he led a group whose activities extended from commercial maritime operations to an Italian shipyard acquisition.

long_biography.plain_text:
Maritime businessman James Frangi has argued that construction quality is best judged inside the yard, before finishes conceal the structure. He encouraged buyers to examine a boat's underlying build and systems, placing greater weight on the people doing the work than on an established brand's reputation.

At SSH Maritime, he also encouraged Sophi Horne as she moved from branding and graphic design towards boat design. Then the firm's creative director, she was introduced to naval architects and returned to study for a bachelor's degree. Horne credited Frangi's confidence in her when describing that change of direction.
